score_band.method: 10th-90th pct over leave-one-indicator-out + 200 Dirichlet weight draws (conc=60, seed=42)

decomposition.convention: z-contributions are exact and additive; points are pro-rata shares of (score-50)

change_attribution.note: Attribution of score(t)-score(t-1) to each indicator's movement in weighted z-space, pro-rata in points.

divergence.rule: underperforming if EP labor-stress minus TX >= +10 for 2 consecutive months; outperforming if <= -10; else tracking

headline_convention: latest month at which every expected indicator has a z-score; later partial months are nowcasts
